Ukraine
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Budapest, Hungary.
Visa is not required for a period not exceeding 30 days, within a period of two months from the date of the first entry for the following types of travel documents for citizens of BiH:
Regular passport NO
Regular biometric passport NO
Service/Official biometric passport NO
Diplomatic biometric passport NO
Citizens of Ukraine do not require a visa when entering/exiting or passing through the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina for a period not exceeding 30 days, within two months from the date of the first entry.
Holders of diplomatic and service passports of the Ukraine are exempted from the visa requirement when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina.
